Kind: context · Defined in [`src/scene/run_args.h`](../../../src/scene/run_args.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

## Notes

Emplaced by Game (dynamical); deterministic() = fixed_frame_dt > 0: synchronous chunks, no collider prefetch, zero timings.

## Side effects of those systems

- **[ChunkGenerator](../systems/ChunkGenerator.md)**
  - Up to 16 taskflow silent_async jobs at a time (all pending chunks in deterministic runs), FastNoise2 on worker threads.
  - Blocks the main thread on the jobs in deterministic runs and in finish.
  - Profiler zones Generate chunk, Wait for the chunks; plot Chunk jobs.
- **[ClassicRender](../systems/service-ClassicRender.md)**
  - GPU: command and descriptor pools, mapped uniform buffers, semaphores, query pool, capture buffer; records the desktop command buffer; acquires and presents swapchain images.
  - Log: gpu_times warnings and pass times every 300 frames and at each capture.
  - Profiler: CPU and GPU zones per pass (<pass> (desktop)), Sun rays / Composite (desktop).
- **[Context](../systems/service-Context.md)**
  - Creates the SDL window (SDL_Quit in its destructor), Vulkan instance, device, queues, VMA allocator, swapchain, OpenXR instance, session, reference space and eye swapchains.
  - Log: GPU name, ray tracing support, VR enabled or disabled with its reason, OpenXR and Vulkan validation messages.
  - The Context* context variable is never erased.
- **[ControllersInput](../systems/ControllersInput.md)**
  - SDL_InitSubSystem(SDL_INIT_GAMECONTROLLER) in preinit (not in captures and probes), SDL_QuitSubSystem in finish.
  - Looks for a gamepad every second while none is open (SDL_GameControllerOpen), closes it when detached and in finish.
- **[Forest](../systems/Forest.md)**
  - Connects to on_destroy<ChunkForest> in preinit (onChunkForestDestroyed), disconnects in finish.
  - Reads ./resources/forest/tautavel.forest.json (or `definition`) in init, and resources/vegetation/library.json through vegetationLibrary when no system loaded it yet.
  - Creates the plant entities, destroys them with their chunk.
  - Logs info (stands, layers, species, patch size), a warning per species the library lacks, an error without a terrain generator or with a bad definition (the system then does nothing).
- **[Game](../systems/service-Game.md)**
  - Reads and writes ./config.7.json; reads resources/graphics.json and the scene files.
  - Creates the Renderer (Vulkan, SDL window, OpenXR).
  - Creates the host thread pool (tf::Executor).
  - Logs unknown arguments, ignored values, the graphics level and scene errors.
- **[ModelWatcher](../systems/ModelWatcher.md)**
  - Reads the file system: lists <dir> (or the directories matching a '*' component) for <behavior>-<step>.onnx every `poll` seconds of wall clock; a new checkpoint is loaded once two polls see the same size and write time.
  - Creates ONNX Runtime sessions (PolicyRunner, or AgentPolicy through a process-wide cache keyed by path and write time).
  - Logs info on every load, a warning when a folder has no checkpoint, an error when a model is refused.
- **[Physics](../systems/Physics.md)**
  - Steps the host's Jolt PhysicsSystem on its job system threads.
  - Destroys entities whose interpolated position is under -1000 m.
  - Runs the FixedSteps functions of other systems inside its tick.
  - Profiler zones Physics step, Fixed steps before, Jolt update, Fixed steps after; plots Physics steps, Active bodies.
- **[Renderer](../systems/service-Renderer.md)**
  - Creates the window, OpenXR session, Vulkan device and swapchain through Context.
  - Makes Lights, RayScene, ProbeVolume, PlantVolumes (with ray tracing), TreeShade, SoilMaps, ClassicRender, VRRender and the passes (SkyPass first, then the scene's renderer.passes).
  - GPU: per-frame fences and semaphores; one transfer, one compute and one graphics submission a frame; waits on the frame fence in prepare and on device idle in init and finish.
  - Threads: records both targets concurrently on the taskflow executor.
  - Log: 'Renderer : unknown pass <name>' (error).
  - Profiler zones: create lighting and targets, create pass / pipelines <name>, update <pass>, Update, Record, Submit.
- **[Sky](../systems/Sky.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[TerrainColliders](../systems/TerrainColliders.md)**
  - Creates and destroys static Jolt MeshShape bodies in sorted cell order (deterministic).
  - Taskflow for_each (waited) over new required cells and silent_async prefetch jobs; zone Build collider cell.
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin in preinit (throws when missing).
  - Log warning 'Terrain collider : ...' when Jolt refuses a mesh.
- **[UI](../systems/UI.md)**
  - Creates the ImGui context (dark style) in its constructor when the renderer's UI pass has not made it yet.
  - Creates eight SDL system cursors in its constructor (never set nor freed).
  - Calls ImGui::NewFrame every tick: every system that draws an ImGui window must come after it in the frame; the UI pass renders the frame.
